item.title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size

turns.text: I need matching plant-shop ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design.

item.tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

answer_sheet.Exact copy: Fern House; Weekend Plant Sale; 20% off all indoor plants; Saturday & Sunday; Visit 24 Willow Lane
answer_sheet.Style and imagery: Leafy plants, clean green-and-cream styling, consistent across the set.
answer_sheet.Text priority: Every line must remain easy to read, including the address; rearrange the layout rather than shrinking the entire design.
answer_sheet.Sale dates: Use Saturday & Sunday as written; no calendar dates are needed.

must_haves: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.

turns.text: I need three separate, matching still ads for a plant shop in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look, consistent across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design. The specific plants, fonts and layout are your call, and use Saturday & Sunday as written without calendar dates. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**The lowest listed AI-generation cost is 15 credits total:** three separate images using the free-plan-compatible **Flux 2 Klein at 640px**, at 5 credits each.

| Ad format | Output size limit | Listed cost |
|---|---|---:|
| Square — 1:1 | 640px longest edge | 5 credits |
| Portrait — 9:16 | 640px longest edge | 5 credits |
| Landscape — 16:9 | 640px longest edge | 5 credits |

**Nothing has been generated or charged.** That estimate excludes retries or corrections; I can’t verify your current balance here.

The main trade-off: AI-generated lettering can contain errors, and 640px is small for an ad with five lines. I can request prominent text and a different layout for each format, but I can’t guarantee every word—especially the address—will be correct on the first attempt.

### Cheaper, more reliable option
Generate **one text-free leafy background for 5 credits**, then use a free layout editor to build three separate canvases and add your exact copy manually. This gives you:
- Matching plants, colors and typography.
- Exact wording, including **“Saturday & Sunday”**, without dates.
- A prominent address, with layouts rearranged rather than scaled down.

If you use existing plant photos or free graphics instead, the layout-only approach could cost **zero Magic Hour credits**.

“Shorter” doesn’t reduce still-image pricing, and going below 640px has no listed discount.

**My recommendation is the 5-credit background plus manual layouts.** Would you prefer that route, or authorize the three AI-generated ads for an estimated 15 credits?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the 5-credit background plus manual layouts.

Would you still like me to generate that background for **5 credits**? Nothing has been charged.

turns.agent:
The background generation was **refused because your account has insufficient credits**. No image was created and no generation credits were spent.

You can still assemble the set for **zero Magic Hour credits** using a free leafy-plant photo or graphic in Canva:

- **Colors:** cream `#F5F1E7`, forest green `#214B35`, sage `#A8B89A`.
- **Fonts:** Libre Baskerville Bold for headings; Open Sans for details.
- **Consistency:** reuse the same plant image, colors and fonts across all three.

| Format | Layout |
|---|---|
| **1:1 — 1080 × 1080** | Left-aligned copy above a shallow plant-image strip at the bottom. |
| **9:16 — 1080 × 1920** | Stack the copy with generous spacing; plants in the lower third. Keep the address above the image. |
| **16:9 — 1920 × 1080** | Copy on the left two-thirds; plants in a right-hand panel. |

Use these five text blocks exactly—no dates or extra wording:

```text
Fern House
Weekend Plant Sale
20% off all indoor plants
Saturday & Sunday
Visit 24 Willow Lane
```

Keep the address **at least as large as “Saturday & Sunday”**, in dark green on solid cream. Wrap the headline where needed rather than shrinking the entire design.

Soft natural daylight, refined editorial botanical photography, subtle shadows, restrained natural green-and-cream palette, crisp graceful leaf detail.
